chunks.text:
[Setting Out]
{the lead alone sings the rising three-note lift of the hometown tune, then bass, harp and drums join and the road theme strides off}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
plucked harp arpeggios like chiming buoys
bouncy plucked sampled bass rocking root and fifth
light sampled 16-bit snare brushes and soft kick on a walking beat
adventurous walking theme for the first route of a journey
melody built on the hometown tune's rising three-note lift, now springing forward
